notes: CR: Stalled -> effectively closed-lost as of 2026-02. POC completed 2026-01; final security debrief cancelled by customer. Summary: customer ran a 3-week POC with our hosted API + dedicated sandbox. Primary goals: replace LexaAI for contract Q&A, structured clause extraction (JSON output), and deterministic tool-calling (calendar/CLA API) for scheduling and signatures. Outcome: technical fit positive on latency and throughput, but they reported a quality regression vs incumbent on two fronts: (1) structured output stability — multiple schema mismatches in JSON extraction (missing fields, differing key names) that required brittle post-processing; (2) tool-calling reliability — Redwood's function-calling occasionally emitted malformed payloads and inconsistent invocation order vs LexaAI's tuned system. Quote from POC lead: "We saw good token cost numbers but the JSON outputs were noisy and required manual cleanup — not acceptable for legal workflows." Security notes: asked for SSO+SCIM, EU data residency for some workloads, and HSM-backed KMS. Security raised 4 PoAM items (see SEC-7789) including audit trail format and retention policy — unresolved before procurement freeze. Sales motion: AE pushed a demo of dedicated + private deployment to address residency and KMS; SE ran fine-tuning and schema-guided prompting experiments, produced incremental improvements but not parity with incumbent's deterministic function-calling. Business context: internal champion (Head of Automation, Drew Lang) left company in Jan 2026; successor focusing on cost savings -> budget freeze for new vendors. Competitive situation: LexaAI offered a short-term migration incentive and a hosted fine-tuning + deterministic function-calling SLA; customer accepted due to lower integration risk. Key takeaways for Redwood: quality/regression vs incumbent matters more than raw throughput/cost in regulated/legal workflows. Next recommended play: prepare a focused deliverable (schema-locked inference demo + function-calling contract with deterministic delivery and stronger regression test suite) and target re-engagement when budget reopens.
